title: Past life?
content: I tried out a filter on tiktok that tells your “past life” born date and death date… it said I died in Cape Town, South Africa (I’ve never been outta the US btw)…. Sooo on a hunch i googled malls in Cape Town and I be damn if that Canal Walk Shopping center resembles my mall world…. Look familiar to anybody else?? Also the Victoria Wharf Shopping Center!?
